title: What did old India call squares, cubes and their roots?
description: The old Indian words for square, cube, square root and cube root are named, and the word root is explained. Keeko doubts which way the root points, thinking the root grows out of the square.
teaching_notes: One idea: a root is what a square or a cube grows from, like a plant from its root. Watch for students who think the root grows out of the square.

source: Name the Indian words for the square, the cube, the square root and the cube root, and explain what the word root means.
video_script.why: The child learns the old Indian words for square, cube and their roots, and sees why the word root is used: a number grows from its root as a plant does.
video_script.substitution: Match each word to its meaning, then read root as the thing a square or a cube grows from.
video_script.anchor: a plant growing from its root beside a square of tiles growing from its side
video_script.wrong_answer: the root grows out of the square
video_script.wrong_move: Keeko reads root the wrong way round and thinks twenty five is the root of five. A plant grows from its root, so five is the root and twenty five grows from it.
video_script.payoff_line: The words are varga, ghana, varga mula and ghana mula

final_answer.value: Varga, ghana, varga-mula and ghana-mula; root means what the square or cube grows from
final_answer.spoken: varga, ghana, varga mula and ghana mula; root means what the square or cube grows from

hold_back: Varga, ghana, varga-mula and ghana-mula; root means what the square or cube grows from
maths_rules: varga is the square figure and the square power; ghana is the solid cube and the cube power
mula means the root of a plant, a basis, cause or origin; varga-mula is the square root and ghana-mula is the cube root
mula was later matched in Arabic by jidhr and in Latin by radix
video_script.design: One idea: a root is what a square or cube grows from. Wrong idea: the root grows out of the square. The plant and the tile square stay in the anchor band and the words build on the working board.
